files.title: Eukore, whole
files.what: every file of the package: the marker genes, rDNA, organelle genes, metadata, taxonomy and benchmarks, with the manifest of their sizes and MD5s

files.title: Marker genes with introns
files.what: the BUSCO genes and Eukore's own marker loci, each copy whole from first to last codon (exons and introns), one FASTA per locus; with their tables (copies, loci, exons and introns) and species.tsv, genomes.tsv

files.title: Marker genes without introns
files.what: the same copies' coding sequences (exons joined) and proteins, one FASTA per locus; with copies.tsv, loci.tsv, species.tsv, genomes.tsv

files.title: rRNA operons and organelle markers
files.what: nuclear rDNA records (18S spans and whole operons: 18S, ITS1, 5.8S, ITS2, 28S, 5S), their 18S V1-V9 and in-silico PCR; the mitochondrial and plastid genes (12S, 16S, 5S, COX1, CYTB, rbcL, matK, ...) with their coding sequences, proteins and PCR; species.tsv, genomes.tsv (the organelle molecules whole are in the complete package)

files.title: Species
files.what: one row per species: supergroup, group, NCBI's lineage and six references'

files.title: Genomes
files.what: each species' genome: accession, quality flags, rRNA copies, genetic code, duplication

files.title: Cross-references
files.what: each species' Open Tree, GBIF, WoRMS, IRMNG, UNITE SH and BOLD ids

files.title: Assemblies
files.what: each genome's size, contiguity, gaps, GC, masking, telomeres, organelle molecules, where it came from

files.title: NCBI's assembly summary
files.what: NCBI's own row of every genome

files.title: Codons
files.what: the genetic-code check's evidence per genome
